name: claude-remote-control
description: Self-hosted, multi-device remote control for Claude Code — run and watch parallel sessions from your Mac, VS Code, or phone, with real-time sync and a take-control lock.
author: Zawaer

pnpm.comment: React Native (mobile) pins React 18, while web runs React 19. Force ONE @types/react across the workspace so no package sees two unrelated React type copies (which broke the web + mobile typechecks). 18 is the common denominator: RN needs it, react-markdown accepts >=18, and web's standard component code typechecks fine against it.
